note: Engental to Johann Amerbach: De specillis pro me… paria duo aut tria. Living personal 2–3 pair order.
Thanks Amerbach for the pairs he bought: cum illorum specillorum duo paria juncta naso meo adpono. ONSET first-person wear on the nose. Adult concave/distant (Sforza class) not juvenile Huygens.
Died 7 Jan 1511. Survival bound only — do not use as labor tip.
